context_requirements: Expression of beta-2 adrenergic receptor (ADRB2) or alpha-1 adrenergic receptors (ADRA1A/B/D)
Constitutive or ligand-driven adrenergic signaling that supports proliferation or survival
Intact p53 pathway for apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest responses
For HIF-related effects, VHL deficiency or constitutive HIF activation
falsifiers: No change in proliferation or apoptosis markers at 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
No decrease in CCND1, MYC, or other cell-cycle genes at 24 h
No increase in CDKN1A or apoptosis markers at 24 h
Strong and consistent transcriptional response in all nine lines, including HA1E, which lacks relevant adrenergic signaling

evidence.supports: Propranolol inhibits neuroblastoma growth via beta-2 adrenergic receptor, induces apoptosis and decreases proliferation
Propranolol decreases Ki-67 and Bcl-2 and increases p53 in breast cancer
Doxazosin inhibits EGFR and NF-kappaB signaling to induce apoptosis in breast cancer cells
Beta-2 adrenergic receptor antagonist ICI-118,551 blocks HIF signaling in hemangioblastomas
Doxazosin reverses hepatic stellate cell activation via induction of senescence
